xuric: xuriq — it reached, it arrived; x- completive + u- 'it' + riq 'find, reach'
xalan: xalan — she gave birth; al 'child' + -an, which makes a verb (inferred); the root of kalaxik
macu: mak'u — but not, not then; ma 'not' + k'u 'then', written as one word
yaque: yake — (inferred) come forth, be born; the verb of yakeik (xe yake wi 'they came forth there'), after Brasseur 'ils se produisirent'
varic: warik — sleeping, sleep; war 'sleep' + -ik, the ending of an intransitive verb (ke warik 'they sleep')
ꜩaca: tzaqa — (guess) throw down, cast away; after Brasseur 'jeter dehors' and tzaq 'fall'; verb
chach: chach — (guess) loud, crying out; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'ils ne font que crier'
chicu: chik'u — now then, again then; chik 'now, again' + k'u 'then' written as one word
chaquimal: chakimal — (guess) rivalry; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'rivaux'; paired with q'aq'wachib'al
ꜫaꜫvachibal: q'aq'wachib'al — envy (inferred); q'aq' 'fire, red' + wach 'face' + -ib'al, perhaps 'burning face'
culax: kulax — (inferred) be received; kul 'meet, receive' + passive -ax (xe kulax 'they were received')
quetaam: ketaam — they know (it), they knew; k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + etaam 'know'; also of owning someone as kin (mawi ketaam 'they would not know them', inferred)
quiy: kiy — (doubtful reading) grow, multiply; taken as ꜭiy (modern k'iy) with the letters as written, after Brasseur 'ils furent élevés'
nimaquir: nimaqir — grow up, become great; nimaq 'great' + -ir 'become' (xe nimaqir 'they grew up')
rail: rail — (guess) hardship, great works; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'grands travaux'
caxcobizaxic: k'axk'ob'isaxik — being made to suffer (inferred); k'axk'ol 'suffering' + causative -ob'is + passive -ax + -ik
ahzibab: ajsib'ab' — painter, writer; aj- 'one who' + tzib' 'paint, write' + -ab'; written with plain z
xquetaam: xketaam — they knew it; x- completive + k- 'they' + etaam 'know'
poizaxic: poisaxik — (guess) given offence, provoked; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'provoqués'; passive in -ax-ik
loꜫoxic: loq'oxik — being loved, held dear; loq' 'love, hold dear' + passive -ox + -ik
ia: ya — give; verb, written with i for y, with no doer named (mawi chi ya ki wa 'their food was not given')
xhaninac: xjaninaq — (doubtful, guess) finished eating; read from the letters, sense after Brasseur 'le repas était terminé'
vainac: wainaq — (inferred) having eaten; wa 'food' + -inaq, the state reached
cacaric: kakarik — (inferred) growing angry; kakar 'be angry' (the kakal 'angry' of the glossary, a guess) + -ik (ke kakarik 'they grow angry')
oiouaric: oyowarik — raging; oyowal 'anger' made a verb + -ik (ke … oyowarik 'they rage')
cuya: kuya — (inferred) endure, bear it; verb, after Brasseur 'se contentant de souffrir'
ti: ti — (inferred) eat (flesh); verb, after Brasseur 'les mangeaient'
xcacar: xkakar — she grew angry; x- completive + kakar 'be angry' (see kakarik)
iucaam: iukaam — (doubtful) you (pl.) carry; i- 'you (pl.)' + ukaam 'carried', as written; the letters respelled, as kukaam
tanatob: tanatob' — (guess) got caught, were entangled; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'se sont embarrassés'
caꜩ: qatz — our elder brothers (in the speech of the younger); qa- 'our' (q- before a vowel) + atz 'elder brother'; the partner of chaq' 'younger brother' · katz — their elder brothers (in the narrative); k- (ki- 'their' before a vowel) + atz 'elder brother'
cazah: qasaj — (inferred) bring down, lower; qaj 'go down' + causative ending
iuvꜭ: iwuk' — (doubtful) with you (pl.); i- 'your (pl.)' + uk' 'company', with a glide w
chacouic: chakowik — (guess) overcoming, winning; chak 'beat, overcome' + -ow, the ending of a verb that names the doers (not a passive), + -ik (xe chakowik 'they were the ones who overcame')
ꜩolcomih: tzolkomij — (guess) turn about, overturn; not clear, sense after Brasseur 'nous changerons' (qa tzolkomij 'we turn about'); verb
eu: eu — (doubtful reading) not understood; left undivided before pam 'belly' (Brasseur 'et (la forme de) leur ventre'); perhaps e u 'they, their'
cante: Kante — Cante, name of a tree; Brasseur notes can-te 'yellow wood' in Tzeltal and Maya, not K'iche'; kept as a name
chitihc: chitijk — (doubtful, guess) chirping; not clear, perhaps a slip for chitijik, sense after Brasseur 'gazouillaient'
maihan: maijan — (inferred) marvel, wonder; verb, after Brasseur 's'émerveillaient' (xe maijan 'they marvelled')
xnimar: xnimar — it grew great; x- completive + nim 'great' + -ar 'become'
xzipoh: xsipoj — (inferred) it swelled; verb, after Brasseur 'grossit'
vchanic: uchanik — (guess) its happening; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'Comment ceci nous est-il arrivé'
xibin: xib'in — frighten, be frightening; xib' 'fear' + -in (ka xib'in 'it frightens')
quira: kira — untie, loosen; verb, from kir
iuex: iwex — your (pl.) loincloths; i- 'your (pl.)' + ex 'loincloth', with a glide w
vꜩam: utzam — its end, its tip; u- 'its' + tzam 'nose, beak, point'
hure: jure — (guess) pull; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'tirerez par derrière'
huruba: jurub'a — (guess) pulled; verb with -a, taken with jure, after Brasseur 'en tirant'
coy: k'oy — monkey; noun, written with plain c (the house word is ꜭoy)
vachibeh: wachib'ej — (inferred) take on the face, the likeness of; wach 'face' + -ib'ej, verb (xki wachib'ej 'they took on the likeness')
vohon: wojon — (guess) grimacing; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'grimaçant'; paired with silaj
zilah: silaj — (guess) swinging; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'se balançant'
ivaꜩ: iwatz — your (pl.) elder brothers; iw- 'your (pl.)' + atz 'elder brother'
icalaba: ikalab'a — (guess) you (pl.) ruin, lay waste; i- 'you (pl.)' + kalab'a 'lay waste' (a guess), sense after Brasseur 'vous m'avez ruinée' (mi xin ikalab'a 'you have ruined me')
ichiquiba: ichikib'a — (guess) you (pl.) cast down, overwhelm; i- 'you (pl.)' + a verb not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'abîmée de tristesse'
xchivil: xchiwil — you (pl.) shall see; xchi- 'shall' + iw- 'you (pl.)' + il 'see'
xque: xke — (inferred) they shall; x- future + ke 'they', before a verb
vtihouic: utijowik — its testing, its trial; u- 'its' + tij 'try, test' + -ow + -ik
taqui: taki — (guess) take care; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'prenez garde'
xꜩeenic: xtze'nik — laugh, laughing; x- (perhaps ix 'you (pl.)' run into mi, Brasseur m'yx-tzeenic; inferred) + tze'n 'laugh' (tze' 'laughter' + -n) + -ik (mi xtze'nik 'do not laugh')
cahhana: kajjana — (doubtful reading, guess) now, try; read from the letters, sense after Brasseur 'Éprouvez maintenant'
zuanic: suanik — fluting, playing the flute; su 'flute' made a verb + -ik
zuah: suaj — play the flute; su 'flute' made a verb

__broaden__.vachih: wachij — (uncertain) effort (inferred, after Brasseur); not otherwise known · wachij — (inferred) faced it, was there to see; wach 'face' + -ij, after Brasseur 'La vieille n'assista pas'
__broaden__.cabichal: kab'ichal — (uncertain) meaning not known; paired with telen, the pair read 'on the shoulder' after Brasseur; the letters respelled · kab'ichal — (inferred) the two of them, together; after Brasseur 'à l'un ou à l'autre'

__broaden__.naquila: naqila — anything, something; indefinite pronoun · naqila — what (in a question, mi xki kulwachij 'what have they met'); same word as the indefinite

__broaden__.cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun · qaj — we want; q- 'we' (before a vowel) + aj 'want', as xkaj 'they wanted' · qaj — go down, descend (inferred); verb, as in qajik 'descending' · kaj — (inferred) they want; k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + aj 'want', after chi of wishing (chi kaj ta 'let them be willing'); the same letters as qaj 'go down'
__broaden__.catit: qatit — our grandmother; qa- 'our' + atit 'grandmother' · katit — their grandmother; k- (ki- 'their' before a vowel) + atit 'grandmother', in the narrative (ruk' katit 'to their grandmother')
__broaden__.quilo: qilo — we see (it); q- 'we' (written qu before a vowel) + il 'see' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb · kilo — they see it; k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + il 'see' + -o (ka kilo 'they see it')
__broaden__.vve: uwe — if, whether; we 'if' written vv (Brasseur divides u ve); the first v is not explained (uncertain) · uwe — (inferred) yes, as a reply; the we 'yes' written vv (Brasseur Uve, 'C'est fort bien')
